import hashlib
import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

repo = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root = repo / '.cache/quality-20261103/V150-objective-floor-v1'

def read(p):
    return json.loads(p.read_text())

def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def checked(binding):
    p = Path(binding['path'])
    assert str(p).startswith(str(repo) + '/'), p
    assert sha(p) == binding['sha256'], p
    return p

final = read(repo / 'docs/results/v150-objective-floor-final-v1.json')
copies = final['copies']
assert len(copies) == 14
for x in copies.values():
    before, after = checked(x['original']), checked(x['public'])
    assert before.read_bytes() == after.read_bytes()
manifest = read(checked(final['figures']))
assert len(manifest['images']) == 72
by_original = {x['original_image']['path']: x for x in manifest['images']}
triplets = 0
repeated_channels = 0
for item in manifest['images']:
    p = checked(item['image'])
    assert p.read_bytes() == checked(item['original_image']).read_bytes()
    arr = np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGB'))
    assert item['no_resize']
    for panel in item['panels']:
        x, y, w, h = panel['xywh']
        assert (w, h) == (160, 160)
        assert arr[y:y+h, x:x+w].shape == (160, 160, 3)
    if 'triplet_source_board' in item:
        triplets += 1
        board = by_original[item['triplet_source_board']['path']]
        assert item['triplet_source_board']['sha256'] == board['image']['sha256']
        for key in ['case', 'ROI_xywh', 'exposure', 'contrast', 'anchor']:
            assert item[key] == board[key], key
        board_array = np.asarray(Image.open(checked(board['image'])).convert('RGB'))
        by_label = {p['label']: p for p in board['panels']}
        assert len(item['panels']) == 3
        for panel in item['panels']:
            reference = by_label[panel['label']]
            x, y, w, h = panel['xywh']
            bx, by, bw, bh = reference['xywh']
            assert np.array_equal(arr[y:y+h, x:x+w], board_array[by:by+bh, bx:bx+bw])
            repeated_channels += w*h*3
assert triplets == 24 and repeated_channels == 5_529_600
bundle = read(checked(final['source_bundle']))
assert len(bundle['frozen_neural_source_hashes']) == 85
for path, expected in bundle['frozen_neural_source_hashes'].items():
    assert sha(Path(path)) == expected
for source in bundle['additional_sources']:
    assert checked(source).read_text() == source['text']
for key in ['preparation', 'summary', 'checkpoint']:
    checked(final[key])
for binding in final['endpoints'].values():
    checked(binding)
view = read(root / 'native-viewing-v1.json')
checked(view['figure_manifest']); checked(view['viewing_journal'])
assert view['primary_indices_covered'] == list(range(72))
assert len({s for e in view['events'] for s in e['sheets']}) == 18
execution = read(root / 'execution-completion-v1.json')
assert execution['recorded_owner_count'] == 10
assert all(x['terminal_state'] == 'absent' for x in execution['owners'])
assert not execution['live_matching_root_argv']
scores = read(root / 'scores-v1.json')
adc = [x for x in scores['rows'] if x['kind'] == 'flat' and 'adc-only' in x['id'] and x['method'] != 'parent']
assert len(adc) == 48*4 and all(not x['changed'] and x['correction_RMS_DN16'] == 0 for x in adc)
real = [x for x in scores['rows'] if x['kind'] == 'real']
assert len(real) == 30 and all(not x['reference_scored'] for x in real)
assert read(root / 'independent-training-audit-v1.json')['status'] == 'pass-both-finite-states-and-exact-native-control-reproduction'
assert read(root / 'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')['status'] == 'pass'
assert len(scores['rows']) == 4686
binding = read(root / 'report-table-bindings-v1.json')
table = binding['cells']
report = (repo / 'docs/objective-floor-training.md').read_text()
assert all(line in report for line in binding['lines'])
for cell in table:
    g = next(x for x in scores['summary'] if all(x[k] == cell[k] for k in ['kind', 'condition', 'cohort', 'method']))
    assert f"{g[cell['field']]:.{cell['digits']}f}" == cell['rendered']
    assert cell['rendered'] in report
route = read(repo / 'docs/results/v150-objective-floor-routing-v1.json')
assert checked(route['auditor']).read_text() == route['auditor']['text']
assert len(route['groups']) == 24
for key in ['training', 'cache', 'training_audit']: checked(route[key])
assert (repo / 'docs/results/v150-objective-floor-training-state-v1.json').read_bytes() == (root / 'independent-training-state-audit-v1.json').read_bytes()
docs = ['docs/spectral-loss-allocation.md','README.md', 'docs/objective-floor-training.md', 'docs/current-model.md', 'docs/index.md', 'docs/research.md', 'diary/2026-11-03-15-03-40-v150-objective-floor-trial.md']
link_count = 0
for name in docs:
    p = repo / name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', p.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):
            continue
        target = link.split('#')[0]
        assert (p.parent / target).is_file(), (name, target)
        link_count += 1
result = {'status': 'pass', 'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(), 'final_evidence_sha256': sha(repo / 'docs/results/v150-objective-floor-final-v1.json'), 'byte_exact_receipt_copies': len(copies), 'byte_exact_primary_PNGs': 72, 'native_cell_dimensions': [160, 160], 'repeated_triplets': triplets, 'independently_rechecked_repeated_RGB_channels': repeated_channels, 'frozen_neural_source_hashes_checked': 85, 'endpoint_exports_and_checkpoint_SHA_checked': 5, 'actually_viewed_sheets': 18, 'terminal_primary_owners': 10, 'exact_parent_ADC_predictions_checked': len(adc), 'real_rows_unscored': len(real), 'all_score_rows': len(scores['rows']), 'report_table_values_checked': len(table), 'full_report_table_rows_checked': len(binding['lines']), 'existing_local_document_links_checked': link_count, 'verifier_source': {'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': sha(Path(__file__)), 'text': Path(__file__).read_text()}, 'scope': 'Publication, reference, native repeat-cell and rounded report-number verification only. No new neural evaluation/noise generation. Original scientific audits and all historical receipts preserved.'}
(repo / 'docs/results/v150-objective-floor-final-verification-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != 'verifier_source'}, indent=2))
